name: Crystal Onion Armor

start.dialog: *dual-layered rustling* We have heard of Prism crystals! POWER crystals! We need them for ULTIMATE armor! Layer upon layer! SPARKLE upon SPARKLE! Bring us Prism shards! Many!
start.objective: Collect 15 Prism crystal shards for the Onion Bosses' armor

progress.dialog: *impatient wobbling* More crystals! More SPARKLE! We must be the SHINIEST!

complete.dialog: *ecstatic jiggling* SPARKLES! We BLIND enemies with GLORY! Here - Crystal Onion Ring! Makes YOU shiny too! Layers of protection! *proud double pose*

party_comments.kade: Two onions. Working together. In crystal armor. Sure.
party_comments.twist: They look like disco balls! I love it!
party_comments.nix7: Refractive index of onion-crystal composite: fascinating.

hidden_outcome: If you bring 30 crystal shards, the Onion Bosses fuse into 'Super Onion' and give you the 'Onion Ring' - ultimate accessory
